en.hubeali: Muhammad Bin Yahya, from Ahmad Bin Muhammad Bin Isa, from Al Husayn Bin Saeed, from Fazalat Bin Ayoub, from Ibn Sinan,

(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullahasws regarding the Words of Allahazwj Mighty and Majestic [7:31] O Children of Adam! Take to your adornments at every Masjid. Heasws said: ‘During the two Eids and the Friday’.
en.sarwar: 8. Muhammad ibn Yahya has narrated from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn ‘Isa from al-Husayn ibn Sa‘id from Fadalah ibn Ayyub from ibn Sinan who has said the following:
“About the words of Allah, most Majestic, most Glorious, ‘spruce yourselves up near every Masjid,’ [7:29] abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘It is a reference to both ‘Id and Friday.’”
